worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.summary: Fire an electric beam that raises Sp. Atk on hit and deals follow-up damage. Longer charging increases its power and range.
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.use.0: A charged thin beam at mid-to-long range
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.use.1: Flood Sp. Atk back on a hit and set up the next spell
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.use.2: Chip from a distance before closing
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.description: The beam strikes a target within %2$s blocks for %1$s power at %3$s blocks/tick; it only makes limited corrections, so a hard sideways move still dodges it.
The beam has a %1$s-block radius; on a hit, %2$s chance for the residual current to flood back and raise Sp. Atk by %3$s stage.
%2$s ticks after a hit, the residual current bites the impact point for %1$s of the direct hit.
Overcharge: 5 ticks more windup and a longer cooldown, but range ×1.2, power ×1.2, a higher surge chance and denser arcs.
Quick shot: shorter and cheaper and it flies faster, with less range and a lower surge chance.
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: beam damage %2$s, the surge raises %3$s Sp. Atk stage.
On: 5 ticks more windup and a longer cooldown, but range ×1.2, power ×1.2, a higher surge chance and denser arcs. Off (quick shot): shorter and cheaper and it flies faster, with less range and a lower surge chance.
Beyond this distance the partner closes in instead of firing; larger means it will open from further away.
On: while Sp. Atk is below +4 stages, rank the beam higher to bank that stage first. Off: never chase the buff on purpose.
